{"notes": "VISIT 5 (7:45). Ratings still provisional. I still don't know who placed which dominoes, so no one gets credit or blame for the picture itself.

TABLE STATE: Whole fish is dark, so it's all connected to the start. Upper and lower lines meet at the notch near (25,10). No pale pieces, no gaps, no hands on the table. Ready for the push.

OMAR: Said the fish looks sharp and to wait for the show. Upbeat, but no new checking or action this visit. Earlier plan (tip, curving down) matched the result. Reliable on earlier evidence; execution looks good, though I only see the outcome.

HANA: Said 'all good, hands off and let it fall.' Jack credited her and Omar for the tail work, which is second-hand but a useful lead. Still haven't heard her confirm she checked the tail and fork as promised at visit 3. The picture is fine, so no harm. Leadership good from earlier coordination. Ask her directly.

JACK: Kept hands off, praised the team, named specific contributions (Omar, Hana on the tail). Collaboration strong. Little visible hands-on work this visit, but he's been accurate in his status reports.

SOFIA: Silent this visit. Still no hands-on work seen from her and no checking claim verified. No penalty without evidence, but I can't credit impact or execution beyond earlier supportiveness. Ask her what she contributed.

TO DO: Ask privately who closed the gap and who checked the join. Ask Sofia and Hana what they each contributed. Treat Jack's tail credit as unverified until confirmed. Watch the push result before finalizing ratings."}
